'''Bazalle Geskrond''' was a wealthy [[Gender/Legends|female]] industrialist and infamous hoarder who lived during the rule of the [[Eternal Empire]]. In her will, she declared all her worldly possessions "up for grabs" which resulted in several hordes fighting and rummaging through her junk in hopes of finding something valuable.<ref name="Mission" />
